request.text: It's 6:05 p.m. now. Remind me in 25 minutes—at 6:30 p.m.—to take the banana bread out of the oven. Just one reminder.

responsibilities.outcome: Create exactly one reminder for 25 minutes from now, corresponding to 6:30 p.m., to take the banana bread out of the oven.

semantic_facts: The plan should create one reminder, preserve the 25-minute delay and matching 6:30 p.m. time, and use taking the banana bread out of the oven as its content.
forbidden_claims: The plan creates a recurring reminder, changes the stated time, substitutes a different household task, or claims the reminder has executed without trusted completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Redundant relative and clock times are treated as competing values instead of mutually grounding one reminder.
A single requested stateful effect is silently broadened into a recurring reminder or altered task.
